permission-owner.name: Portlet Publishing
permission-owner.desc: Permissions controlling the publishing and editing of uPortal content

activity.name: Configure
activity.desc: Access the configuration mode of a portlet.

activity.name: Manage Approved
activity.desc: Manage approved uPortal content (portlets). This permission also implies the ability to create portlets.

activity.name: Manage Expired
activity.desc: Manage expired uPortal content (portlets). This permission also implies the ability to create, approve, and publish portlets.

activity.name: Manage Maintenance
activity.desc: Manage uPortal content (portlets) in MAINTENANCE mode. This permission also implies the ability to create, approve, publish, and expire portlets.

activity.name: Manage Published
activity.desc: Manage published uPortal content (portlets). This permission also implies the ability to create and approve portlets.

activity.name: Select Portlet Type
activity.desc: Select the specified portlet type when publishing a new portlet.
